items.title: Awesome Neovim
items.content_text:
### Programming Languages Support / Markdown and LaTeX

*   [Zeioth/markmap.nvim (⭐206)](https://github.com/Zeioth/markmap.nvim) - Visualize your Markdown as mindmaps.

items.content_text:
### Programming Languages / Julia

*   [Manifest2Nix.jl](https://codeberg.org/aniva/Manifest2Nix.jl) - A Nix library for creating reproducible Julia builds and experiments via precompilation.

### Programming Languages / Python

*   [uv2nix (⭐583)](https://github.com/pyproject-nix/uv2nix) - Convert [`uv` workspaces](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/workspaces/) into pure Nix derivations.
